unresolved_findings.issue: The 24h window filter compares started_at >= <T-format ISO> lexicographically. Production writes T-format timestamps (scanner._utc_now uses isoformat) so the boundary is correct there; the tests inject same-day rows (space-format datetime('now')) which compare fine against yesterday's cutoff. A space-format timestamp from the boundary day itself would compare out of the window (' ' < 'T').
unresolved_findings.disposition: Non-blocking; no action needed while scanner._utc_now remains the only scan_runs writer. Normalize to a stored ISO comparison in any future touch.
